a: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ، وَلاَ مُوَدَّعٍ وَلاَ مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ، رَبَّنَا
p: Al-ḥamdu lillāhi kathīran ṭayyiban mubārakan fīh, ghayra makfiyyin wa lā muwaddaʿin wa lā mustaghnan ʿanhu rabbanā.
m: All praise is for Allah, abundant, good and blessed praise. Our Lord, we are never able to repay it, nor leave it, nor do without it.
